description: Defines ASN.1 structures and classes for BCCH-DL-SCH message types in 3GPP RRC NR protocol, including choice and sequence structures with serialization and JSON conversion methods.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the message type choice for BCCH-DL-SCH messages, including options for sys_info and sib_type1.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the BCCH-DL-SCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type or choice option.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.
